text:
maria: Quick thread to settle console observability scope for next release. Core asks from Sales: per-route cost breakdown, error analytics with trace links, and a lightweight tracing hook that doesn't explode telem costs. Need to decide M1 vs M2 and owners.

lee: TL;DR proposal: M1 = per-route cost widget + error buckets (drop/retry/timeout) with trace id links. M2 = sampling slider + per-route overrides + full-span ingestion. Rationale: cost attribution unblocks customers.

tracy: Customer feedback (CondorHealth + QuantumBank): if per-route cost is missing we won't get buy-in. They can tolerate basic trace links (no full spans). They want daily cost rollups and 30d lookback.

ron: Engineering constraints: full-span ingestion adds ~3-4x storage. Alternative: trace-index only (store trace id + summary) + on-demand fetch for full spans if enabled. That gives most UX value without constant storage.

maria: Acceptance checklist draft:
```
- Cost widget: shows per-route token_count, embedding_count, estimated $ cost; default time windows: 7d, 30d
- Error analytics: group by error class (drop/retry/timeout), show example traces (trace id links) and top affected routes
- Tracing hook: annotated server spans (metadata) emitted for sampled requests; trace-id surfaced in error logs and dashboard links
- Rollout policy: canary to 3 pilot orgs for 1 week, telemetry cost delta <25% required to proceed, rollback if error rate regresses >1.5x
- Tests: synthetic prompt replay + cost smoke test; UI acceptance flows for drilldown
```

lee: +1. Also: add a low-cost retention tier: trace-index retained 90d, full-span retained 7d by default. infra-bot will need a ticket for storage path.

infra-bot: New infra ticket created: INF-2042 (trace-index path + retention tiers).

tracy: UX notes: provide an "expand" affordance on the widget that surfaces top 5 traces and a CTA to request full span. Keep the widget compact on dashboards. I'll drop mockups in Figma: https://redwood.internal/figma/observe-cost-compact

ron: Dev plan: runtime change to emit annotated spans (RUNTIME-5120), new ingestion pipeline flag to enable trace-indexing (PIPE-3344). Estimate: 2.5 weeks for runtime + 1.5 weeks infra work in parallel.

maria: Prioritization decision: ship M1 as cost widget + trace-index + error buckets. M2 (sampling UI + per-route overrides + full spans) deferred to next quarter. Anyone opposed?

lee: No objections. Suggest we add an ops guard to auto-disable full-span per org if telemetry spend > threshold.

tracy: Agree. Also need documentation: how to interpret cost numbers (token pricing assumptions, rounding). I'll author a one-pager.

maria: Owners: lee -> backend trace-index + cost API, ron -> runtime annotated spans, tracy -> UX + docs, infra-bot -> INF-2042. Ron/Lee, please post PR-level estimates by EOD tomorrow.

infra-bot: Reminder: Roadmap sync Wed 09:30 PT.

maria: OK marking this as roadmap commit for next release unless major objections by EOD. Thanks. :rocket:
